meta.notes: CIs: 2,000 event-cluster resamples (400 for ece and calSlope). ECE is biased upward under resampling (noise in 10 bins), so its interval is a spread, not a CI around the point estimate. Base-rate 'actual' 10-8 share is implied from card totals (19 x rounds - card sum; deductions count as 10-8s). Stat-line deviance: Poisson deviance of each fighter's actual fight total vs the simulated mean (unconditional on fight length), averaged over both fighters
